answer: In this economy an identity's weight rests only on its reef of quorum-matched grading verdicts, each one sealed on-ledger and re-checked against consensus. That sealed record is the sole signal peers read, and it is as hard to counterfeit as carving quartz: it cannot be minted, bought, or handed to a clone. A sybil swarm of M fakes shares no history, so each identity must grade its own way up from zero, and the attacker's bill scales linearly with the number of fakes.
